summary: Schools Beyond Screens & Fairplay urge the FCC to maintain E-Rate funding to ensure safe and effective EdTech use in schools, opposing any reduction in funding to address excessive screen use. The text argues for the implementation of phone-free policies in schools and the assessment of EdTech safety and effectiveness to ensure they improve learning outcomes and do not pose risks to students. The comment opposes any measures that would reduce, restructure, or condition E-Rate connectivity funding, emphasizing the importance of broadband access for schools and the potential negative impact on other programs if funding is reduced. The comments highlight concerns about the impact of reducing E-Rate subsidies on schools and the need for alternative solutions to address excessive screen time and EdTech issues. The comments propose that the federal government should take a more active role in regulating and addressing these issues through existing authorities and legislation, rather than relying solely on funding limitations.
